header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: When the Prophet ﷺ said, “On the Day of Qiyamah Allah will raise some people with their faces shining with light. They will be seated on pulpits of pearls, and people will envy them. They are neither Prophets nor martyrs (Shuhada),” a (Sahabi) villager sat on his knees and asked, “Ya Rasulallah! Describe to us who they are, so that we may know them.' The Prophet ﷺ said, “They are those from various tribes who, out of love for Allah, came from various places, gathered together and engaged in the Dhikr of Allah.” Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) has narrated this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَسَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: عَنْ يَمِينِ الرَّحْمنِ وِكِلْتَا يَدَيْهِ يَمِينٌ رِجَالٌ لَيْسُوا بِأَنْبِيَاءَ وَلَا شُهَدَاءَ يَغْشَي بَيَاضُ وُجُوهِهِمْ نَظَرَ النَّاظِرِينَ يَغْبِطُهُمُ النَّبِيُّونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ بِمَقْعَدِهِمْ وَقُرْبِهِمْ مِنَ اللهِ قِيلَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ مَنْ هُمْ؟ قَالَ: هُمْ جُمَّاعٌ مِنْ نَوَازِعِ الْقَبَائِلِ يَجْتَمِعُونَ عَلَي ذِكْرِ اللهِ فَيَنْتَقُونَ أَطَايِبَ الْكَلَامِ كَمَا يَنْتَقِي آكِلُ التَّمْرِ أَطَايِبَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني ورجاله موثقون مجمع الزوائد:١٠ /٧٨
blocks.tamil_translation: When the Prophet ﷺ said, “Some people will be on the right side of Ar-Rahman. (Both hands of Allah are right hands.) They are neither Prophets nor martyrs. The light of their faces will draw those who look towards them. Because of their high rank and the nearness they have with Allah, the Prophets and martyrs will envy them,” the Prophet ﷺ was asked, “Who are they?' “They are those who came out from various tribes, leaving their relatives, and gathered together (in one place) to do the Dhikr of Allah.
